title: Internal: Mid-Tier Card Retention Offer Update (Effective 09/01/2025)
content:
## Updated Offer

- Effective 09/01/2025, the statement credit retention offer for mid-tier cards (Silver Rewards, Business Silver Rewards, Green Rewards and Silver Zoom) is $35. The bonus points alternative remains 2,000 points.
- Retention offers for entry-tier and premium-tier cards are unchanged.
- Apply the credit with apply_statement_credit_8472, reason 'retention_offer'.
